title: LADA Doofers vs Rainucks, Nov 8
notes: Home game at Snoqualmie B: we wore white and had the left bench. The game sheet (SportNinja, through its public API, LADA game 33035) gave the score, the goals, the penalty, the shots and who played. YouTube's upload sat 70 px low; fetch shifted it into place.

Periods by the scoreboard clock (we were HOME): 0:09-18:10, 19:48-37:50 and 39:34-1:03:35 of the video, which runs to the final horn. The clock ran through stoppages in the 1st and 2nd. Shots on goal 21-32 (7-9, 9-7, 5-16), as on the sheet and the board.

Goals at 6:46 (Rainucks #22 Sreibers), 20:30 (#77 Warness from #19), 25:43, 26:24 and 36:53 (Panov #76's three, 41 s apart for the first two and the last with 55 s left in the 2nd) and 51:50 of the video, each found by eye and matched to the board. The sheet credits the 3rd-period goal against to #46 Werre; the video shows their #32 picking up the loose puck and scoring. On Panov's first goal the shooter's number isn't readable through the scramble; the page credits the sheet's #76.

Akulov #37's hooking (2:46 left in the 1st, 14:50 of the video) was a 3-minute minor, not the 2 the sheet says: the panel posted 3:00. He sat from 15:10 to 20:03 of the video, 14 s into the 2nd; the kill held.

Twelve skaters and Wheeler #0 in goal. Absent: Belousenko #11, Zakharankau #97, goalies Mayorov #1, Starodubtsev #20 and Fisenko #58, and all the subs. The sheet marks #2 Caraza Duhne as playing, but no white #2 or that nameplate showed up in any crop or check, so he isn't on the page.

Rainucks wear navy and also have a #38 and a #46: the P3 roster card's #38 row was their #38, and the solver had given most of Tislenok #38's 3rd-period shifts to others (4:38 in P3 before the frame checks, 9:28 after). Two rounds of frame checks added 46 on/off spans, and one more was set by hand (#38 off in the stoppage at 51:20-51:46).

Left open: at 48:06-48:25 of the video the solver has four of ours on; the fifth was #71, #75 or #76 (a black-shorts, striped-sock skater whose second digit no check could read). Panov #76's 1st period (2:27) may be short: a check found him only at 10:11-10:17 beyond the solver's shifts.

highlights.note: 1st period, clock 11:22: Sreibers #22 stuffs it in at the left of our crease after our goalie goes down, unassisted, 0-1
1st period, clock 2:46: hooking in our zone; a 3-minute minor that ran 14 s into the 2nd, killed
2nd period, clock 17:15: Warness #77 takes a feed from #19, drives the net and jams it in, 0-2
2nd period, clock 12:05: a shot from the slot through a crease scramble, Panov #76 from Polyanskiy #46 and Polyanskiy #52, 1-2
2nd period, clock 11:22, 41 s later: Panov #76 takes a feed at the right of the crease and cuts across the sprawled goalie, from Polyanskiy #46 and Komashinsky #13, 2-2
2nd period, clock 0:55: off an offensive-zone faceoff, Polyanskiy #52 feeds Panov #76 at the crease for his hat trick, from #52 and Komashinsky #13, 3-2
3rd period, clock 9:22: their #32 picks up a loose puck left of our net and beats our sprawled goalie at the post (the game sheet credits #46 Werre), 3-3
